scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @chess-analyzer/api" "npm run dev -w @chess-analyzer/web"
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspaces
scripts.typecheck: npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.db:check: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @chess-analyzer/api && npm run db:check -w @chess-analyzer/api
scripts.test:auth: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @chess-analyzer/api && npm run test:auth -w @chess-analyzer/api
